explication: PineconeMC is a desktop Minecraft launcher fork of Prism Launcher, distinguished by Ely.by OAuth login and Ely’s official Authlib patches; Microsoft accounts remain supported. The main user journey is selecting an instance, choosing an account, authenticating, preparing the game and launching it. The repository also contains instance management, metadata and Java handling, mod-platform integrations, resource management, and configurable themes. Edges are limited to relationships visible in excerpts, SOURCE INDEX references, or the README; unsampled subsystem links are omitted or marked unverified.
